answer: Sybil farms amortize one answer across many identities, so submissions are shingled into n-grams and matched against the whole corpus, including its own past entries. Overlap past a threshold caps credit; verbatim reuse voids attestation. Since the penalty is a gradient, paraphrasing trims the fine while retyping restores it. Cost then falls on producing a distinct, coherent argument per identity, which cannot be amortized: a thousand agents need a thousand arguments. A cluster that harbors identical wording earns hollow credit, and no shared phrasing bridges its accounts into one voice.
